0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_000010_ALPHINAUD
0.description: Ishgard cannot well endure another assault. Even should her knights succeed in turning back the Horde, the casualties will be catastrophic.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_000020_TATARU
1.description: But what other choice do we have? It's not like we can talk it over with them. Dragons and men aren't exactly on speaking terms.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_000050_ALPHINAUD
4.description: When last you spoke with her, she lamented her crimes, did she not?

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_000060_ALPHINAUD
5.description: Then there remains a sliver of hope. If we can persuade Iceheart to act as our intermediary, we may yet be able to convince Nidhogg to abandon his bloody course.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_000070_ESTINIEN
6.description: If there is to be a meeting, I would accompany you.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_000090_ESTINIEN
8.description: Even with your intermediary, Nidhogg's bloodrage may render him deaf to reason. However, the mere attempt may afford our forces precious time to prepare.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_000100_ESTINIEN
9.description: Of course...you might also consider a more direct approach to ending this conflict. With the power of the Eye at my disposal, and the vaunted strength of the Warrior of Light, we could conceivably slay the beast outright...

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_000110_ALPHINAUD
10.description: If we are to risk a face-to-face meeting with the dread wyrm, I for one would feel safer in the company of the Azure Dragoon. However, I should only turn to your lance if my words failed to find their mark. Is that clear?

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_000120_ESTINIEN
11.description: Perfectly. I shall assume that Iceheart enjoys similar diplomatic protection until instructed otherwise.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_000130_ESTINIEN
12.description: A word of advice: think carefully before divulging the particulars of this plan to Ser Aymeric. 'Twould not do to have the lord commander accused of consorting with heretics.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_000140_ALPHINAUD
13.description: Indeed. I thank you for your counsel, Estinien. We shall be honored to have you with us.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_000150_ESTINIEN
14.description: I am glad to be of service.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_100010_AYMERIC
15.description: I want the defenses of the outer ward rechecked. See to it that the ballistas are in good repair and supplied with enough ammunition for a prolonged siege.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_100030_AYMERIC
17.description: Ah, 'twould seem I have visitors─and unlike those massing beyond our walls, these ones are welcome.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_100040_ALPHINAUD
18.description: Pray forgive us for interrupting you in the midst of your preparations, Ser Aymeric, but our suit concerns the impending assault. To speak plain, we believe there is a chance the invasion might be halted before it even begins.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_100050_ALPHINAUD
19.description: I can divulge little more at this time, but I must nevertheless request that you advise the Holy See to refrain from launching any preemptive sorties whilst we seek to put our plans in motion.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_100060_AYMERIC
20.description: I will gladly lend my support to any endeavor that could spare the blood of my countrymen─but I would know more of the cause you would have me champion. Will you not share aught of this mysterious undertaking?

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_100070_ESTINIEN
21.description: Know that I have offered my lance to aid in this endeavor. I cannot claim that its success is assured, but our actions should serve to delay Nidhogg's advance at the very least.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_100080_ESTINIEN
22.description: Which is more than can be said for the ill-conceived counterattack advocated by the See's more vocal crusaders. They offer glorious death, but little hope of victory.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_100090_AYMERIC
23.description: Aye...their proposal does not inspire confidence. Our resources should rightly be spent shoring up the city's defenses.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_100100_AYMERIC
24.description: Hmmm. The Azure Dragoon and the Warrior of Light, sallying forth together to face the dread wyrm, Nidhogg...

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_100110_AYMERIC
25.description: I must admit, the mere thought of it does much to dispel my misgivings. Go, then─carry out your plan. I shall do what I can for you within the Holy See.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_200020_ZEPHIRIN
27.description: Yes, Your Eminence. The bells of the Observatorium warn of our enemy's approach...

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_200040_THORDAN
29.description: Let them come─in their hundreds and their thousands. With the divine blade in our hands, we shall rend their flesh and drown the heretics in their masters' blood. Even Nidhogg and his foul brood shall be powerless to resist us.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_200050_THORDAN
30.description: And when we have rid the world of their pestilence, we shall turn our attention to our Ascian allies─see that they are suitably rewarded for their invaluable assistance.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_200060_ZEPHIRIN
31.description: If I may, Your Eminence. The Paragons wield powers strange and unknowable. Can we be certain that they will not see through our deception?

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_200070_THORDAN
32.description: We can be certain of naught save the righteousness of our cause. If you would be a true leader of men, you must possess conviction as well as caution.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_200080_THORDAN
33.description: We seek to excise the root of an evil that has blighted us for a thousand years. The risk is worth the reward.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_200090_ZEPHIRIN
34.description: And what of Estinien and this Warrior of Light? They have plans of their own...

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_200100_THORDAN
35.description: Leave them to their purpose. We must each play the role we have been given...you and your chosen brothers most of all.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_200110_ZEPHIRIN
36.description: For the glory of King Thordan...

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_300010_ICEHEART
37.description: (-Iceheart-)Ah, I should have known it would be you...

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_300020_ICEHEART
38.description: (-Iceheart-)Word reached me of a struggle with a small but well-armed band of trespassers. Forgive my comrades their hostility─few come here uninvited, and fewer still with good intent.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_300030_ICEHEART
39.description: (-Iceheart-)Now, tell me why you are here.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_Q1_000_1
40.description: What will you say to Lady Iceheart?

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A1_000_1
41.description: We wish to stop Nidhogg's attack on Ishgard.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A1_000_2
42.description: We wished to speak with you.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_300040_ICEHEART
44.description: (-Iceheart-)So, you seek to stem the Dravanian tide with talk? A romantic notion.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_300050_ICEHEART
45.description: (-Iceheart-)If you but knew the truth─the spark which lit the flames of this animosity─you would understand the futility of your quest.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_300060_ICEHEART
46.description: (-Iceheart-)Shall I relate it to you? The sordid history my gift has shown me? That which the Holy See has taken such pains to suppress?

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_400010_ICEHEART
47.description: (-Iceheart-)'Twas more than a millennium past when an Elezen tribe first sought to claim the lands of Coerthas as its home.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_400020_ICEHEART
48.description: (-Iceheart-)Unfortunately for them, Coerthas was already home to dragonkind, and they were not inclined to make way for the invaders. Thus did a bloody war begin─a war which might well have rumbled on until one or the other side was exterminated, had it not been for the resolve of a single woman. That woman's name was “Shiva.”

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_400030_ICEHEART
49.description: (-Iceheart-)While those around her fought and died, she attempted to parley with the dragons, and in so doing discovered them to be possessed of profound intelligence and reason. The great wyrm Hraesvelgr in particular so enchanted Shiva that she found herself growing to love the creature, whom her people considered a monster.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_400040_ICEHEART
50.description: (-Iceheart-)In the eyes of a near-immortal dragon, however, the fleeting life of an Elezen is as that of a freshly cut rose─scarce has the flower bloomed before it begins to fade and wither.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_400050_ICEHEART
51.description: (-Iceheart-)Such melancholy musings plagued Hraesvelgr, who had found in Shiva an unexpected and beloved soulmate. He knew that all too soon, death would snatch her away from him.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_400060_ICEHEART
52.description: (-Iceheart-)Unable to bear the thought of their separation, the maid bid the wyrm consume her, that their spirits might be entwined for eternity.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_400070_ICEHEART
53.description: (-Iceheart-)...Though loath to perform the deed, Hraesvelgr ultimately gave in to her plea, and soon thereafter, the tale of their ill-fated love spread throughout the two warring factions. No more could they raise blade or claw against one another, knowing that the souls of their kin were so inextricably bound.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_400080_ICEHEART
54.description: (-Iceheart-)In the days that followed, man and dragon learned to live in harmony, and together built a nation unlike any the world had ever known. For two hundred years did this blissful age of peace continue, as it would to this day, had vilest envy not stirred in the hearts of the Elezen.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_400090_ICEHEART
55.description: (-Iceheart-)It is said that wyrms owe their longevity to the boundless reserves of vitality found within their eyes─and 'twas in this belief that a traitorous band of knights deceived their allies of some two centuries, and took by force that which they coveted...

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_500010_ICEHEART
56.description: (-Iceheart-)Nidhogg─he who now stands poised to unleash his wyrmlings upon Ishgard─was the great dragon who lost an eye to Elezen treachery.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_500020_ICEHEART
57.description: (-Iceheart-)And until he prises it from the hands of the traitors' progeny, no amount of conciliatory words will stay his fury.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_500040_ESTINIEN
59.description: Lest you misunderstand, I do not doubt your vision of the past─'tis true that Nidhogg greatly desired to reclaim the Eye.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_500050_ESTINIEN
60.description: Indeed, it was for that very reason that I kept it with me as I roamed the land, attempting to draw him away from the city.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_500070_ESTINIEN
62.description: Until recently, Nidhogg seemed unable to resist its allure, and pursued me relentlessly. Needless to say, that is no longer the case. Now, it would seem he has fixed his attention on Ishgard itself, though he knows full well the Eye does not reside there.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_500080_ICEHEART
63.description: (-Iceheart-)You believe he targets the capital for another reason...?

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_500090_ESTINIEN
64.description: I believe reason has all but left him. Through the Eye, I feel much of what Nidhogg feels, and the dragon's thirst for vengeance will not be quenched by aught less than a sea of blood.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_500100_ALPHINAUD
65.description: If Nidhogg is indeed lost to reason, might we not seek an audience with Hraesvelgr instead?

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_500110_ALPHINAUD
66.description: He has thus far shown no inclination to aid in the invasion of Ishgard, and may yet welcome our efforts to broker a peace.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_500120_ICEHEART
67.description: (-Iceheart-)You <hex:021A020203>still<hex:021A020103> believe that a peaceable solution can be found? Very well. I will take you to him.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_500130_ICEHEART
68.description: (-Iceheart-)Our road will lead us to Dravania, the homeland of dragonkind. There we shall ascend unto the clouds, where Hraesvelgr resides...

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_600020_ALPHINAUD
70.description: I sense the many battles are beginning to take their toll. Rest awhile. And should you lose sight of us─Dravania lies beyond the mountains to the west.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_600030_MIDGARDSORMR
71.description: Curious... The vestiges of thy mistress's blessing are not as faint as once they were...

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_600040_MIDGARDSORMR
72.description: Thy will to succeed grants thee unusual fortitude. But will it be enough...?

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_700010_EDMONT
73.description: Beyond Abalathia's Spine─the great mountain range<hex:02100103>that spans the continent of Aldenard from east to west...

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_700020_EDMONT
74.description: Into the deepening shadows of Sohm Al,<hex:02100103>where lies the ancient home of dragonkind...

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_700030_EDMONT
75.description: To a land where the soil slithers, and the skies seethe<hex:02100103>with sinuous shapes, they came.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800020_VIDOFNIR
77.description: Ah, 'tis thee, Little One. From above, I did mistake thee for a Gnath. 'Tis well I chanced to look again, or thou wouldst now be ash.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800030_ICEHEART
78.description: Dear Vidofnir...how I have missed you. Would that I had come sooner...and not out of dire necessity.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800040_VIDOFNIR
79.description: Thou art troubled. Speak, that I might know thy plight.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800050_VIDOFNIR
80.description: Thou wouldst have Father admonish his brood-brother?

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800060_ICEHEART
81.description: I would end this war without further bloodshed.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800070_VIDOFNIR
82.description: How am I to believe thee, Little One...when thine own companion beareth Nidhogg's stolen eye!?

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800080_ESTINIEN
83.description: Have care, dragon...or I shall gouge out one of yours.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800090_ICEHEART
84.description: You forget yourself, ser! We are here on a mission of peace!

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800100_VIDOFNIR
85.description: My sire's will forbiddeth me from inviting discord to our home... 'Tis for this reason, and no other, that thou still drawest breath, knight.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800110_ICEHEART
86.description: Vidofnir, please─we must be allowed to convey our intentions to Hraesvelgr in person, with words of our own choosing.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800120_ICEHEART
87.description: Grant us this favor, and open the way to Sohm Al!

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800130_VIDOFNIR
88.description: Thou hast ever been welcome, Little One.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800140_VIDOFNIR
89.description: ...But I cannot grant thy wish. I am bound to remain here, and protect my kin from the Gnath's god.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800150_ICEHEART
90.description: The Gnath have summoned a primal!?

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800160_ALPHINAUD
91.description: Pray excuse my forwardness, but if we were to eliminate the threat to your territory, would you consent to Lady Ysayle's request?

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800170_VIDOFNIR
92.description: Ha! Dost thou imagine thyself equal to the task─to succeed where dragons have failed?

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800180_VIDOFNIR
93.description: 'Tis beyond thee, mortal. But thou art welcome to try, nonetheless. Only know that idle promises shall avail thee naught!

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_800190_ICEHEART
94.description: It would seem we have no choice but to make good on Alphinaud's offer. Why must our every bid for peace breed yet more war?

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810010_ICEHEART
95.description: Now we have but to wait...

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810020_GNATHPRIEST
96.description: O Lord Ravana! Master of the Sacred Blades! Wrath of the Colony! Conqueror of the World! Hear our prayer!

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810030_GNATHPRIEST
97.description: Pray grant unto Your devoted children the gift of Your divine presence!

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810050_RAVANA
99.description: All strength to the colony. Speak and I shall listen!

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810060_GNATHPRIEST
100.description: O Glorious General! We have captured intruders, and would make unto You an offering of their life's blood...

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810070_RAVANA
101.description: These feeble fleshlings dared to invade Gnath lands?

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810080_ICEHEART
102.description: Hear me, Lord Ravana! My companion and I did not come to contest your children's territory.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810090_ICEHEART
103.description: We wished only to learn the reason you wage war against the dragons.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810100_RAVANA
104.description: Thou wouldst flirt with death merely to satisfy thy curiosity? Wherefore should the glorious conquests of the Gnath concern thee so, Elezen?

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810110_RAVANA
105.description: ...Ahhh, mayhap thine own kind's struggle against the wyrms fareth poorly, and thou art desirous of a pact.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810120_ICEHEART
106.description: We crave no alliance, Lord Ravana─only peace. We would bring an end to our war with the dragons. Yet so long as they remain embroiled in this conflict with your children, our goal shall remain out of reach.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810130_ICEHEART
107.description: Never before have the Gnath risen up in such numbers, and never yet with you at their head. Why do you lead them to war?

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810140_RAVANA
108.description: Thy question hath no meaning. To live is but to fight.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810150_RAVANA
109.description: Long have my children waited, gathering their strength in the shadow of thy ceaseless conflict.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810160_RAVANA
110.description: The Gnath would see the Dravanians slain, and their territory secured─and by such fervent prayers am I now given form and purpose.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810170_ICEHEART
111.description: As I feared, your very existence is an obstacle to our goal. Since you are so fond of fighting, we challenge you, Lord of the Gnath!

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810180_ICEHEART
112.description: And should we emerge the victors, I would have you swear to withdraw your soldiers from Dravanian soil!

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810190_RAVANA
113.description: Gahahaha! Thou art bold indeed to risk thy fleshy hide so readily!

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810200_RAVANA
114.description: Very well. I, Ravana, fourfold master of the blade, do accept thy challenge!

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810210_RAVANA
115.description: But should <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> emerge the victor, I would have thee swear to serve in mine army till thy last breath is spent! Do you accept!?

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810220_ICEHEART
116.description: I do! And I believe the first bout is mine!

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810230_RAVANA
117.description: What is this!? A god clad in flesh!?

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810240_ICEHEART
118.description: Is aught amiss, my lord? Thou wilt not break thy word, I trust.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810250_RAVANA
119.description: Mine oath is unbending as steel, little goddess! Thy ruse will but add to mine enjoyment!

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810260_ICEHEART
120.description: I thought myself...stronger... Mayhap with more crystals...?

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810270_RAVANA
121.description: Be thou god or maid, thou art nothing to me! ...And what of thee, mortal? Art thou warrior or craven?

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_810280_RAVANA
122.description: A warrior, then! Good! Mayhap thou wilt provide more sport than thy feeble companion!

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_820010_RAVANA
123.description: Thus doth the sacred rite of combat proclaim the victor...<hex:02100103>I lay my blades at thy feet, child of man...

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_820020_ICEHEART
124.description: You do not disappoint, Warrior of Light. Would that I had your skill in battle. ...I do begin to see why so many place their faith in you.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_820030_ICEHEART
125.description: For all his savagery, I do not think Ravana one to break his word. Provided the dragons do not trespass upon Gnath lands, they should have little to fear of the primal's biting blades. We have done well, have we not? Come, let us return to Vidofnir and share these glad tidings.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_820040_IGEYOHRM
126.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Once more you achieve the impossible, Bringer of Light... But with every mortal heart that succumbs to fear and fury, another voice is joined to the chorus beseeching divine succor.<hex:0248020103>

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_820050_IGEYOHRM
127.description: <hex:024804F2022303>At their bidding, warring gods will shake the firmament, and your world will be consumed in the swelling storm of chaos...<hex:0248020103>

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_900010_EDMONT
128.description: To the peak of Sohm Al, at the end of a perilous mountain path...

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_900020_EDMONT
129.description: Whence could be seen a string of pearl-like islands,<hex:02100103>floating impossibly atop a sea of clouds.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_900030_EDMONT
130.description: To a domain where dragons and men had once lived in harmony, whose majesty<hex:02100103>no mortal eye had glimpsed for nigh on a thousand years, they came.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00010_HRAESVELGR
131.description: Mortals... Why do you disturb my solitude?

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00030_HRAESVELGR
133.description: Thou speakest the name of a creature that but awaiteth the release of oblivion. Leave me...

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00031_ALPHINAUD
134.description: By the Twelve... Mine ears hear the tongue of dragons, yet the meaning rings clear within my mind... How can that be...?

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00040_ICEHEART
135.description: Hraesvelgr...do you not remember me? 'Twas I whom you found in Dravania─I who glimpsed the truth.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00050_ICEHEART
136.description: The truth about your past, about Shiva─

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00060_HRAESVELGR
137.description: Do not speak her name, mortal!

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00070_ICEHEART
138.description: But speak it I must! I have summoned Shiva's soul from the beyond, and offered myself as her vessel! She has made her heart known to me!

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00080_HRAESVELGR
139.description: Foolish girl. Thinkest thou my beloved's spirit hath descended from the heavens!?

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00090_HRAESVELGR
140.description: That the secrets of her heart are thine to know!?

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00100_ICEHEART
141.description: I have surrendered mine to her! Do you not see, my love? I am Shiva reborn!

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00110_HRAESVELGR
142.description: Gullible fool... The Light but illuminated the past for thee, it did not grant thee omniscience.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00120_HRAESVELGR
143.description: The spirit thou hast summoned belongeth not to Shiva─'tis but a shade conjured by thine own fancy.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00130_HRAESVELGR
144.description: In an age long past, mine own kin were guilty of like folly. Beguiled by the dark ones' lies, they attempted to resurrect a king amongst wyrms─yet the divinity they called forth merely borrowed the semblance of my fallen brood-brother.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00140_HRAESVELGR
145.description: Such gods are not summoned, but created. Phantoms spun from the threads of misplaced faith.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00150_ICEHEART
146.description: Then the spirit that answered me...

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00160_HRAESVELGR
147.description: ...Was but thy dream of Shiva. Thy soul hath been corrupted by a deity of thine own making, child.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00170_ALPHINAUD
148.description: Be that as it may, Lord Hraesvelgr, Ysayle's desire to heal the rift between man and dragon is real, and it has borne us this far.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00180_ALPHINAUD
149.description: We would spare both our kind and yours the ravages of this senseless war! Pray join your voice to ours in a call for peace and forgiveness!

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00190_HRAESVELGR
150.description: The tale of thy kind is one of avarice, treachery, and death─and thou wouldst speak to me of peace?

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_A00200_HRAESVELGR
151.description: Hark thee, mortal, to the naked truth...then tell me thou deservest forgiveness!

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_B00010_HRAESVELGR
152.description: Twelve hundred years ago, my beloved Shiva's sacrifice served to bring an end to the war 'twixt man and dragon, paving the way for an age of peace and cooperation.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_B00020_HRAESVELGR
153.description: Two centuries of harmony were to follow, during which time the Elezen learned much about us, not least that the eyes of a great wyrm are the wellspring of his strength.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_B00030_HRAESVELGR
154.description: 'Twas out of the selfish desire to possess this strength that King Thordan then conspired to undo all that our peoples had achieved together.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_B00040_HRAESVELGR
155.description: With the aid of his leal knights, that most noble of Elezen lured my brood-sister Ratatoskr into an ambush, and took from her that which he craved.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_B00050_HRAESVELGR
156.description: Fain would I strike the image from my mind, yet still the scene doth linger─of my brood-sister's tattered corpse, defiled by her Elezen allies. They had torn out her eyes, and feasted upon them in the manner of wild beasts.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_B00060_HRAESVELGR
157.description: Yet that was not all, for from their bloody banquet, the fiends had gained strength beyond that of mortal men... Even now, I labor to comprehend the enormity of their betrayal.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_B00070_HRAESVELGR
158.description: Nidhogg was the first to learn of the atrocity, and he took to the skies, hungry for vengeance.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_B00080_HRAESVELGR
159.description: But though he slew Thordan and some few of his knights, their fellow butchers knew only too well where to aim their spears, and with now-practiced savagery, they set about my brood-brother, sending him flailing from the field...

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_B00090_HRAESVELGR
160.description: Such is the truth the Holy See would keep hidden. Such was the beginning of the Dragonsong War.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_B00100_HRAESVELGR
161.description: 'Tis a song my kind shall ne'er forget, e'en should ten thousand years pass and Ishgard crumble into dust.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00010_ESTINIEN
162.description: Your tale bears scant resemblance to the one I was taught. How convenient that it should absolve your kind of all responsibility. But tell me, dragon: why should I believe your version of events?

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00020_HRAESVELGR
163.description: What thou choosest to believe is immaterial. The betrayal that yet haunts mine every waking moment is no less than the truth to my kind.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00030_HRAESVELGR
164.description: And Nidhogg meaneth for Thordan's people to suffer for this sin till the end of days.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00040_HRAESVELGR
165.description: That which thou imaginest a war of extinction is but a punishment─a siege of the spirit. Hast thou not seen those who tire of the torment? Those who abandon their own and side with dragonkind?

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00060_HRAESVELGR
167.description: Know that all the traitors' progeny bear a trace of Ratatoskr's essence. But a single sip of our blood is enough to awaken it...

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00080_HRAESVELGR
169.description: 'Tis for this reason that those who abandon their loyalties are rewarded with a drink. And thus are they transformed, to join the ranks of Nidhogg's ever-growing army as newborn dragons. One by one, through death or defection, my brood-brother shall account for all of the betrayers' children...

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00090_ALPHINAUD
170.description: Ye gods... I have borne witness to such a transformation! Looked on as a heretic assumed the shape of a dragon... I imagined it some manner of Dravanian enchantment!

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00100_ALPHINAUD
171.description: But if any Ishgardian, regardless of allegiance, has such potential within them... Twelve forgive us. To think of all the dragons we've slain...!

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00110_HRAESVELGR
172.description: There will always be some, of course, who choose to fight until the bitter end─like thee, dragoon...

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00120_HRAESVELGR
173.description: But struggle as thou might, thy youthful vigor will be spent ere thou reachest two score and ten. And Nidhogg shall remain to torment thine offspring.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00130_ESTINIEN
174.description: Oft have I wondered why Nidhogg did not simply raze Ishgard to the ground.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00140_ESTINIEN
175.description: Now I have my answer. He has no intention of winning the Dragonsong War, for it is no war at all, but vengeance─an eternal requiem sung for his murdered sister.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00150_HRAESVELGR
176.description: Thou hast the right of it, dragonslayer. Comprehendest thou now the futility of thy quest?

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00160_ICEHEART
177.description: I have not come this far only to admit defeat. We can still return the Eye to Nidhogg, and beg forgiveness for our ancestors' crimes. Mayhap our words will sway him!

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00170_HRAESVELGR
178.description: Stubborn child... Thou thinkest in mortal terms. Our perception of time is too broad for thee to grasp.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00180_HRAESVELGR
179.description: 'Tis a simple matter for thee to offer thine apologies─thou didst not perpetrate the crime. Despite thy visions, the deeds of history seem distant to thee.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00190_HRAESVELGR
180.description: For a wyrm such as Nidhogg, however, that history is yet part of his present, as fresh as the blood that did gush from Ratatoskr's wounds. How could he not be driven mad?

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00200_HRAESVELGR
181.description: 'Tis only by the calming embrace of Shiva's soul that mine own fury hath not consumed me.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_C00210_HRAESVELGR
182.description: But let us speak no more of what is done. My faith in your kind is spent, and I would be alone.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_D00010_ESTINIEN
183.description: Well, what do you propose we do now? I, for one, am intent on continuing to the east...

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_D00020_ALPHINAUD
184.description: What is there to be found in the east?

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_D00030_ESTINIEN
185.description: Nidhogg's lair─the Aery─is said to lie in that direction. And the Eye tells me he is near...

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_D00040_ICEHEART
186.description: You cannot still mean to slay him!?

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_D00050_ESTINIEN
187.description: You cannot still mean to stop me. I have been true to my word, and aided you in this fool's errand with Hraesvelgr.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_D00060_ESTINIEN
188.description: But your efforts at parley have come to naught, Lady Iceheart. I would see Ishgard saved, and for that, Nidhogg must die.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_D00070_ICEHEART
189.description: With the tale of our ancestors' vile betrayal yet ringing in your ears, you speak of continuing this war?

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_D00080_ESTINIEN
190.description: Nay, lady, I would but pierce its vengeful heart. When Nidhogg dies, this war shall die with him.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_D00090_ALPHINAUD
191.description: A moment, Estinien. You yourself spoke of the great wyrm's strength─that you believed him powerful enough to raze your city to the ground. How then are we few to challenge him?

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_D00100_ALPHINAUD
192.description: Even behind the stout walls of Ishgard─with an army of knights manning the defenses─our victory would be hard-won. Yet you propose to contend with the beast in his own lair?

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_D00110_ESTINIEN
193.description: In close combat, this will afford us an advantage. And if the tales are true, the Warrior of Light has bested many an invincible foe.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_D00120_ESTINIEN
194.description: In close combat, this will afford us an advantage. And with two Azure Dragoons working in unison, who can say what might be possible?

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_D00130_ESTINIEN
195.description: But such speculation is meaningless if we cannot even find the wyrm. Our first task must be to seek out Nidhogg's lair.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_D00140_ALPHINAUD
196.description: The story of this nation grows bloodier by the moment. Must death always be answered with more of the same?

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_D00150_ESTINIEN
197.description: Such is the way of things, I fear. I shall consider it a miracle if mine armor is not stained crimson ere this conflict is ended.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_D00160_ICEHEART
198.description: That I should be blinded by my own lies... Everything I believed... Everything I thought I was... Gone... All gone...

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_D00170_ESTINIEN
199.description: Leave her. Your words will not reach her now. And we have not the time to wait for her to gather up the pieces of her shattered faith.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_E00020_ESTINIEN
201.description: Aye... That would be the Aery. I feel Nidhogg's presence through the Eye─his caustic hatred gnawing at my soul.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_E00030_ESTINIEN
202.description: 'Twould seem the death of his consort has put him on guard. Mark how he wards his lair with tempestuous winds.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_E00040_ALPHINAUD
203.description: A similar barrier once barred our entrance to the primal Garuda's domain...until we discovered the means by which it could be penetrated.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_E00050_ALPHINAUD
204.description: Mayhap it is time we called upon Master Garlond. 'Twill be just like the good old days, no?

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_F00010_WEDGE
205.description: Feast your eyes upon our latest and greatest feat of engineering! We call it a “manacutter”!

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_F00020_BIGGS
206.description: After you put down Gaius, Wedge and me struck out on our own for a bit, and started work on the successor to the <hex:021A020203>Tiny Bronco<hex:021A020103>.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_F00030_CID
207.description: Impressive little thing, isn't she? My talent for ship design has plainly rubbed off on them.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_F00040_CID
208.description: They've adapted the principles of corrupted crystal technology, and constructed a mechanism which converts aether from its surroundings into elemental wind. Said wind is then harnessed by the specially engineered sails, providing the craft with propulsion and lift. All in all, a most elegant solution...

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_F00050_CID
209.description: ...I'm actually a little upset that I didn't think of it myself.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_F00060_WEDGE
210.description: The design does, however, come with one small flaw...

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_F00070_BIGGS
211.description: The energy conversion ratio's bloody awful. To generate enough power to get you off the ground, you need to be in an area awash with predominantly wind-aspected aether.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_F00080_WEDGE
212.description: In other words, there are a few places you can fly...and lots of places you can't.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_F00090_CID
213.description: The new Ishgardian airship hasn't left the boys much time for tinkering─meaning it may be a while before this particular project takes off, if you'll forgive the pun.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_F00120_TATARU
216.description: I've been looking all over for you! There's been word from Ul'dah! It's about Her Grace, the sultana!

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_F00130_CID
217.description: It seems you're required elsewhere. Leave the manacutter with us. We'll see that she's airworthy and suitably equipped to slice through those winds.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_F00140_CID
218.description: You, meanwhile, should concentrate on providing Raubahn and the sultana whatever help they need!

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_G00020_ALPHINAUD
220.description: No thanks are necessary, General. I trust your recuperation continues apace?

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_G00030_RAUBAHN
221.description: I cannot complain. Thanks to Higiri and her ministrations, I've regained much of the strength I lost during my imprisonment.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_G00040_ALPHINAUD
222.description: I gather you have made progress in the search for Her Grace.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_G00050_RAUBAHN
223.description: Aye, some good fortune at last. A few days past, Dewlala informed us that a sizable shipment of alchemical supplies had been delivered to the palace.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_G00060_PIPPIN
224.description: With Papashan's assistance, I set out to ascertain the source and nature of the shipment. My inquiries led me to Frondale's Phrontistery.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_G00070_PIPPIN
225.description: There I learned that an order had been placed for a curious substance designed to sustain patients trapped in deathlike slumber─an invention of the former head alchemist, apparently.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_G00080_ALPHINAUD
226.description: A deathlike slumber...? This cannot be a coincidence!

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_G00090_RAUBAHN
227.description: It lends some weight to Dewlala's claims, aye. Her Grace is likely somewhere within the palace─abed but alive.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_G00100_YUGIRI
228.description: Before making any attempt to extricate the sultana, however, it seemed prudent to learn what manner of substance was used to induce her torpor. To that end, I made inquiries as to the whereabouts of the one most like to have administered it─the lady-in-waiting, Meriel.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_G00110_YUGIRI
229.description: We sent for you as soon as we learned of her location. All that remains is to apprehend the woman.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_G00120_RAUBAHN
230.description: We shall find our cat's-paw in the Silver Bazaar.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_G00130_RAUBAHN
231.description: But we must tread carefully. The market is not the bustling place it once was, and someone is sure to mark our coming. Should they inform the Monetarists, we'll have a fight on our hands.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_G00140_RAUBAHN
232.description: We must be prepared for the worst─and being short an arm, I thought it wise to take another in its stead. What say you, Warrior of Light? Will you lend me yours?

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_G00150_RAUBAHN
233.description: Then I pity the bastard that stands in our way. Come, my friends! For Nanamo...and for Ul'dah!

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00010_ALPHINAUD
234.description: You are Meriel, the sultana's former lady-in-waiting?

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00020_LADYINWAITING2
235.description: I know no one of that name! Pray excuse me...

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00040_RAUBAHN
237.description: We will have the truth from you, girl...

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00050_LOLORITO
238.description: Mayhap 'twould be better coming from me.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00070_LOLORITO
240.description: As you know, Teledji Adeledji's Carteneau Reclamation Bill was no more than a facade─a means to get his grubby little hands on that Allagan monstrosity, Omega.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00080_LOLORITO
241.description: When he learned of Nanamo's intention to abdicate, however, he was forced to amend his plans. Suddenly, assassination seemed the most promising way to further his ambitions.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00090_LOLORITO
242.description: I am told Teledji had discovered a maid in whose veins ran the blood of House Thorne─a new, more pliable puppet to sit the throne. 'Twould have caused an uproar, of course, but few could have contested her claim.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00100_LOLORITO
243.description: 'Twas plain that Teledji's wild machinations had outgrown our ability to control them. So I decided to usurp his scheme, and left the fool to seal his own demise.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00120_LOLORITO
245.description: Oh, I have no desire to harm Her Grace─'twould profit me little to destabilize our government. Thus did I employ young Meriel here to administer a potent sleeping potion in place of a poison.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00130_LOLORITO
246.description: You should know, General, that your dear friend Ilberd was fully aware of my plan.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00140_LOLORITO
247.description: I had him lie about the assassination as a means to prime your rage against Teledji. We weren't entirely sure how you would react, but things went rather better than expected.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00150_RAUBAHN
248.description: You conniving little worm... You had your claws in the Crystal Braves before their first recruit had sworn to serve!

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00160_LOLORITO
249.description: But of course. When a new game begins, 'tis only prudent to have a piece on the board. Ilberd was mine.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00170_LOLORITO
250.description: Truth be told, a significant proportion of the Braves' initial endowment was also mine. With such large sums moving about, 'twas a rather trifling matter to disguise my own contribution.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00180_LOLORITO
251.description: Ah, Ilberd... I secured his services with a promise to support his cause once my authority had been solidified. I swear, the man thinks of naught but prising Ala Mhigo from the grasp of the Empire.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00190_LOLORITO
252.description: Unlike you, General, the poor fellow seems quite unable to forsake the land of his forefathers. Mayhap that's why he called you a traitor to your people and a disgrace to your homeland...amongst other things. What was it he always compared you to? Oh, yes! “An overgrown lapdog, begging for scraps at the sultana's table!” Oh, how we laughed...

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00200_LOLORITO
253.description: Alas, Ilberd's entertaining little outbursts eventually gave way to wearisome tirades, and the zealous brute became rather unruly. I had no wish to see you executed, you understand, but he would not take no for an answer. Rest assured, his employment with me has long since ended.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00210_LOLORITO
254.description: ...Which brings us neatly to the present. What say you, General? Both you and the sultana are alive; we have one corpse and one fugitive; and preparations have been made to restore your good name. Shall we cry quits and start again with a blank ledger? Hm?

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00220_RAUBAHN
255.description: The hells we will! Do you honestly expect me to forgive and forget? After all you've done!? You're guilty of high treason!

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00230_DEWLALA
256.description: Stay your blade, Master Aldynn! You yourself are not innocent! Or have you forgotten your <hex:021A020203>own<hex:021A020103> crime in executing Teledji Adeledji without trial!?

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00240_DEWLALA
257.description: Though you acted out of loyalty to the sultana, such deeds are in violation of both the word and spirit of the law!

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00260_LOLORITO
259.description: This potion will wake the sultana from her slumber. Consider it a gesture of conciliation.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00270_LOLORITO
260.description: You will find Her Grace resting comfortably within her private chambers. Should you doubt my word, I shall willingly accompany you to the palace as your hostage.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00280_RAUBAHN
261.description: I like not your motives, Lolorito...but you saved the sultana's life, and for that you have my gratitude.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_H00290_DEWLALA
262.description: Raubahn Aldynn, you are hereby reinstated as general of the Immortal Flames! The citizens of Ul'dah shall once more be united under Nanamo Ul Namo, and together we shall usher in a new age of prosperity!

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_I00020_NANAMO
264.description: I was having the longest dream...

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_I00030_RAUBAHN
265.description: 'Tis time to wake up, Your Grace. Another day begins in Thanalan, and the sun blazes bright upon the sands.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_J00010_RAUBAHN
266.description: Her Grace is awoken. The palace physician assures me she is none the worse for her slumber.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_J00020_RAUBAHN
267.description: I believe Her Grace will soon resume her plans to place the government of Ul'dah into the hands of its citizens.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_J00030_RAUBAHN
268.description: Whatever path she chooses to take, I shall walk it with her. And we shall tread slowly, lest the nation be unsettled in our wake.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_J00040_LOLORITO
269.description: Her Grace's compassion is a shining beacon to us all...but what our city truly thrives upon is competition.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_J00050_LOLORITO
270.description: 'Tis in the struggle against our rivals that opportunities are seized and fortunes made. And with the Empire on the offensive once more, now would hardly seem the time to turn our system of government upon its head.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_J00060_ALPHINAUD
271.description: Are you privy to new intelligence, my lord?

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_J00070_LOLORITO
272.description: I would hardly call it new. Remind me: what was the name of that enormous imperial warship which met its end in Mor Dhona? Wait, I have it! The <hex:021A020203>Agrius<hex:021A020103>. Yes, well, 'twould appear that the Garleans have been hard at work on another such vessel.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_J00080_PIPPIN
273.description: How close are they to completing this ship!? Is it operational!?

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_J00090_LOLORITO
274.description: Its maiden flight was a success, I hear. I should imagine Emperor Varis is eager to see how it performs in battle.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_J00100_LOLORITO
275.description: <hex:02082DE905FF144D79206C6F72647320616E64206C6164696573FF144D79206C6F7264732E2E2E616E64206C61647903>, I move that it is time to repair the damage caused by Teledji Adeledji, and prepare our great nation to repel the Empire once more.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_K00010_ALPHINAUD
276.description: 'Tis well that the sultana has awoken. The Syndicate yet needs to put its house in order, but 'twould seem the worst of the confusion has passed.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_K00020_ALPHINAUD
277.description: Ul'dah has taken control of its future...and I must do the same.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_K00030_ALPHINAUD
278.description: I have decided to disband the Crystal Braves.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_K00040_ALPHINAUD
279.description: Among the recruits, there were those who supported our order's goals and convictions with all sincerity. 'Tis my hope that these loyal men and women will choose to remain our allies in the battles to come.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_K00050_ALPHINAUD
280.description: As for those who sided with the traitor, Ilberd, they shall be hunted down and held to account for their crimes. It is my earnest hope that they will surrender themselves peaceably when the time comes...though I think it unlikely.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_K00060_ALPHINAUD
281.description: Ah, my all-conquering Crystal Braves... The model army meant to pave the way for a single, unified Grand Company of Eorzea. That so high an ideal should be brought so low...

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_K00070_ALPHINAUD
282.description: I need not tell you how deeply the betrayal stung me. Yet I see now that it was mine own naivety and pride which allowed the Braves to fall prey to corruption.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_K00080_ALPHINAUD
283.description: As ever, it is to your own shining example that I turn for inspiration. Like you, I mean to stand firm in the face of hardship, and give mine all for the cause.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_K00090_ALPHINAUD
284.description: Let us resume the search for our missing comrades, that we might come together to shine the light of dawn across the realm once more.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_K00100_ALPHINAUD
285.description: The role of Crystal Brave commander suited me ill, and I shall play it no longer. Henceforth, I shall be no more or less than Alphinaud, proud member of the Scions.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00020_AYMERIC
287.description: Ah, the moment has come, then?

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00030_ALPHINAUD
288.description: Pray excuse my lateness. I paid a brief visit to the workshop to inquire about the manacutters. The engineers assure me that they are ready.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00040_ESTINIEN
289.description: The Aery is now but a short flight away. Yet what a long and winding path we took to reach this point.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00050_ESTINIEN
290.description: Were it not for Master Alphinaud's proposal, we never would have attempted to parley with the dragons.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00060_ESTINIEN
291.description: Though our negotiations yielded little, our expedition with Lady Iceheart taught us much.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00070_AYMERIC
292.description: You took an unimaginable risk... I could scarce believe the tale Estinien told.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00080_ESTINIEN
293.description: Aye, 'tis true that many of our countrymen would sooner die than join hands with the heretics' mistress, but 'twas through that most unlikely of alliances that we came to speak with Hraesvelgr.

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00090_ALPHINAUD
294.description: A conversation that went rather poorly, as I recall.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00100_ESTINIEN
295.description: In this instance, the journey was more important than the destination. Had we not slain Nidhogg's consort, Tioman, and put the great wyrm on his guard, the Dravanians would have arrived at Ishgard's walls long ago.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00110_AYMERIC
296.description: Aye, that they would. Full grateful am I for every hour of respite your actions have afforded us. Thanks to you, our defenses are much improved. 'Tis but a pity they won't be enough.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00120_ALPHINAUD
297.description: Thus you believe an assault upon the Aery represents the city's best chance of survival. Is that not so, Estinien?

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00130_ESTINIEN
298.description: I am under no illusions. Nidhogg's might is legendary. But with his eye in my possession, I can stifle his strength at the source.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00140_ESTINIEN
299.description: Victory will be hard-won, even so, and I shall be glad indeed to have the Warrior of Light at my side.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00150_AYMERIC
300.description: You shall have my blade as well. There are more of these “manacutters” to be had, yes?

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00170_AYMERIC
302.description: How can I, a proud knight of Ishgard, stand by and do naught while an outsider risks life and limb for our homeland? I swore an oath to protect this city!

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00180_ESTINIEN
303.description: Pray leave the slaying of dragons to dragoons, ser knight. Your duty to command the city's defense is no less vital.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00190_ESTINIEN
304.description: Should we fail, and Nidhogg slip through our grasp, who, then, will hold the walls against him? Will you leave Ishgard in the hands of the Holy See's zealots?

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00210_ESTINIEN
306.description: Who but you has the authority and the standing to orchestrate a citywide defense? I do not, and neither does the Warrior of Light. That is why it is our place to fight, and yours to remain here, Lord Commander.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00220_ESTINIEN
307.description: What, you too, Master Alphinaud? By the Fury... You have shown some promise, but this adversary is far beyond your skills.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00230_ALPHINAUD
308.description: Your candor is appreciated, ser dragoon. I shall remain, then, and cheer you from afar.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_L00240_ESTINIEN
309.description: Well, my friend, 'twould seem I have discouraged the last of the volunteers, and claimed the task as ours alone. But if any alive can best this wyrm, 'tis surely we two!

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_M00020_ESTINIEN
311.description: So, this is the Aery! Where are you Nidhogg!? You have guests!

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_M00040_ESTINIEN
313.description: Greetings, Lord of Dravania! I believe we have something that belongs to you!

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_M00050_NIDHOGG
314.description: Wicked mortals! I shall melt your flesh, and turn your bones to ash!

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_N00010_NIDHOGG
315.description: Thou wouldst use mine own eye against me!? Time hath done naught to dilute thy kind's depravity!

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_N00020_NIDHOGG
316.description: I have not forgotten thee, dragoon! Mine essence claimed thee once...and shall do so again!

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_N00040_ESTINIEN
318.description: You gifted my people a thousand years of suffering. Now I gift you an eternity in darkness!

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00010_SYLVETREL
319.description: They are ours, Lord Haldrath... The eyes of Nidhogg!

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00020_HALDRATH
320.description: Aye... The wyrm lies broken and my father is avenged. With the wellspring of his vitality thus denied him, Nidhogg shall not linger long in this world.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00030_HALDRATH
321.description: But behold the terrible price we have paid. My sire is dead; so many brother knights slain.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00040_HALDRATH
322.description: We traded our honor for the strength which now courses in our veins. And still we are forced to make such sacrifice.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00050_SYLVETREL
323.description: But not in vain, my lord. Hraesvelgr is the only great wyrm left in Dravania, and he dares not leave his lair.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00060_SYLVETREL
324.description: With Nidhogg's eyes in your possession, who now can challenge the might of Ishgard? Ascend the throne, and take your rightful place as the ruler of our people!

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00070_HALDRATH
325.description: Nay, my friend, I must forsake the mantle of king. Though Nidhogg be defeated, his wyrmling horde yet darkens the skies with wings beyond counting.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00080_HALDRATH
326.description: As one who partook of Ratatoskr's strength, it shall be my penance to bear a knight's arms until death grants me leave to retire. When that day comes, no prince shall perish, but a hells-bound hunter of dragons...

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00090_SYLVETREL
327.description: But Lord Haldrath! What then shall become of the royal line!?

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00100_FLAVIEN
328.description: Think of your people, my lord! Without a king, who will the common man turn to in his hour of need? How will he find his way without your benevolent hand to guide him?

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00110_HALDRATH
329.description: I thank you, Ser Flavien and Ser Sylvetrel─for dispelling my remaining doubts. With men of such wisdom and compassion in service to the realm, 'tis plain that Ishgard has no need of a king.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00120_HALDRATH
330.description: But if you must bow to the demands of tradition, you need look no further than yourselves for one worthy to wear the crown.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00130_HALDRATH
331.description: Fare thee well, my brother knights...my loyal friends. On these shoulders shall I bear the weight of my father's sins; with this lance shall I repay the debt accrued through our misdeeds.

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00140_SYLVETREL
332.description: What cruel jest has fate played upon us...? Have we seized this desperate victory only to lose a king?

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00150_FLAVIEN
333.description: We can but act as our lord has bid. We few who remain must divide between us the rulership of Ishgard and her people.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00160_BRAWNYKNIGHT
334.description: Not I. My oath was to Lord Haldrath, and he alone. If he is not to be king, then I would hang up my shield, as well.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00170_SYLVETREL
335.description: Will you abandon us, too, ser?

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00180_BRAWNYKNIGHT
336.description: I would wash my hands of blood and betrayal and take up an honest trade. Mayhap I shall serve ale instead of sharpened steel...

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00210_SYLVETREL
339.description: But four houses to rule all of Ishgard...

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00230_SYLVETREL
341.description: We keep it empty. Until the day a king rises once more, we must assume the role of stewards.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_O00240_SYLVETREL
342.description: We shall shape our nation anew with a history of our own making─and let the truth of this dark day die here, upon the battlefield.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_P00010_ESTINIEN
343.description: What ails you, friend!? Are you wounded?

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_P00020_ESTINIEN
344.description: You have borne witness to history...to the culmination of the first battle with Nidhogg.

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_P00030_ESTINIEN
345.description: The legend of Ishgard's founding tells that our ancestors were led to the land of Coerthas by the valiant King Thordan.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_P00040_ESTINIEN
346.description: In the midst of their journey, they came to a wide chasm, where they were set upon by a great wyrm─Nidhogg. A furious battle then ensued, with Thordan leading the van.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_P00050_ESTINIEN
347.description: Though the brave king was slain defending his people, his son, Haldrath, the first Azure Dragoon, fought on undaunted...

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_P00060_ESTINIEN
348.description: And with a mighty thrust of his lance, he gouged out Nidhogg's eye, forcing the wicked creature into retreat.

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_P00070_ESTINIEN
349.description: Thus did this eldritch orb become a sacred treasure of Ishgard, lending its power to every knight deemed worthy to bear the title of Azure Dragoon.

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_P00080_ESTINIEN
350.description: A rousing tale, is it not? Would that I could still believe it. But your vision, which we must accept as immutable truth, leaves no room for doubt─save on one point.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_P00090_ESTINIEN
351.description: If Haldrath took both of Nidhogg's eyes, then how came this eye to be lodged in the wyrm's skull?

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_P00100_ESTINIEN
352.description: Beneath every answer we unearth, another question lies buried...

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_Q00010_ESTINIEN
353.description: 'Twas a fierce battle, but one I knew we would win. Your fame is well deserved, Warrior of Light. Full proud am I to have fought at your side.

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_Q00020_ESTINIEN
354.description: I would fain return with all swiftness to Ishgard to inform the lord commander of our triumph...

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_Q00030_ESTINIEN
355.description: But we must first have words with Hraesvelgr. There are parts of this tale that the wyrm has kept from us, and I would know wherefore...

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_R00010_HRAESVELGR
356.description: Impenitent mortals, ever seeking to bury old wrongs under new.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_R00020_HRAESVELGR
357.description: I did sense the moment of Nidhogg's demise...

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_R00030_ESTINIEN
358.description: You mean the moment I prised your eye from his head?

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_R00040_HRAESVELGR
359.description: 'Twould seem thou hast uncovered my secret. Aye. Unto the blinded Nidhogg did I yield one half of my strength...

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_S00020_NIDHOGG
361.description: We are undone by covetous mortals. They did take Ratatoskr's eyes...and glut their appetites upon her essence...

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_S00030_HRAESVELGR
362.description: She is slain, then? What madness hath unmade our peaceful accord!?

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_S00040_NIDHOGG
363.description: Did I not warn thee, brood-brother? They have ever been untrustworthy creatures, these short-lived Elezen.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_S00050_NIDHOGG
364.description: But thou wert enchanted by thy mortal maid. Thy folly hath cost Ratatoskr her life, and me mine eyes...

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_S00060_HRAESVELGR
365.description: Oh, my beloved Shiva... How swiftly are thy kin made bestial by their appetites.

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_S00070_NIDHOGG
366.description: Hraesvelgr. 'Twas thy blindness that did invite disaster into our lands. Surrender thee an eye to me, and let that be thy penance.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_S00090_NIDHOGG
368.description: They bested me once, but I was reckless. I shall need but a single eye to inflict enduring torment upon these traitors and every child of their line!

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_S00100_NIDHOGG
369.description: Yield to me thy strength, brood-brother!

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_T00010_HRAESVELGR
371.description: Thou hast borne witness to a scene from my past.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_T00020_ICEHEART
372.description: It was yours... Your strength that sustained Nidhogg all these years...

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_T00030_ESTINIEN
373.description: Would that Haldrath had dealt the wyrm a killing blow...

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_T00040_HRAESVELGR
374.description: When my brood-brother did appear before me, bloody and blinded, his life was all but spent. He demanded half my vigor, that he might exact his revenge upon the mortals who had wronged us.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_T00050_ICEHEART
375.description: And so you acquiesced! You surrendered your eye to Nidhogg knowing full well the suffering he would inflict!

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_T00060_HRAESVELGR
376.description: The peace my beloved so dearly desired had been shattered by her own kin.

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_T00070_HRAESVELGR
377.description: Their treachery claimed my brood-sister's life and my brood-brother's reason! Thinkest thou thy fits of indignation will move me to remorse!?

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_T00080_HRAESVELGR
378.description: Go, mortals! Take your unruly passions and leave this place... Your presence here spelleth naught but misery.

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_T00090_HRAESVELGR
379.description: Were it not for Shiva's soothing embrace, I would slay you where you stand. Woe betide you should the bond we share ever weaken!

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_U00010_ESTINIEN
380.description: 'Twas my life's goal to slay Nidhogg, but I find there is little joy to be had in its accomplishment.

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_U00020_ICEHEART
381.description: But you have rid the world of a hate-filled creature, and ended a bloody war in so doing...

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_U00030_ESTINIEN
382.description: I lost my family to Nidhogg's flames. And 'twas with fury in my heart that I took up the lance. Every blow I struck, I struck in the name of vengeance. We were not so different, he and I.

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_U00040_ICEHEART
383.description: I will not judge you for your deeds─I have not the right. Too many innocents have perished in the name of my “greater good.”

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_U00050_ESTINIEN
384.description: Yet even with all that has passed, the tale is incomplete.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_U00060_ESTINIEN
385.description: We are short a great wyrm's eye. Of the pair which Haldrath took from Nidhogg, only one is known to us─the one I bear. What, then, became of the other?

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_U00070_ESTINIEN
386.description: Why did Nidhogg, who had taken such pains to prolong the Dragonsong War, suddenly decide to hurl his entire army against the walls of Ishgard?

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_U00080_ESTINIEN
387.description: Lord Commander... Aye, the deed is done. Nidhogg is slain.

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_U00090_ESTINIEN
388.description: What? ...In the city!? A battle with whom!?

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_U00100_ESTINIEN
389.description: At once, Lord Commander. Hold firm till our return.

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_U00110_ESTINIEN
390.description: Fighting has broken out in the city. Lord Aymeric was sparse with the particulars, but it seems some commoners threw open the gates to a force of heretics.

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_U00120_ICEHEART
391.description: I gave no order to attack!

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_U00130_ESTINIEN
392.description: Are we to mark the end of the Dragonsong War by spilling the blood of our own? Mayhap Hraesvelgr was right about us...

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_U00140_ESTINIEN
393.description: Let us away, Warrior of Light. The people must be saved from themselves.

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_U00160_ICEHEART
395.description: There has been enough violence. I will appeal to my people in the city and make them see reason!

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_U00170_ESTINIEN
396.description: Come, then, Lady Iceheart. Let us write the final chapter in this damnable war.

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_V00010_ZEPHIRIN
397.description: A small army of heretics has invaded the city, Your Eminence.

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_V00020_ZEPHIRIN
398.description: But there is no cause for concern. A sizable contingent of our soldiers is already in place to repel the Dravanian assault, and the intruders will soon find themselves outnumbered and outmatched.

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_V00040_ZEPHIRIN
400.description: Yes, Your Eminence. This unrest shall serve to feed the people's fear of the heretics and the dragons both.

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_V00050_THORDAN
401.description: And lend renewed fervor to their prayers for deliverance...

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_V00060_THORDAN
402.description: Very good. Grant our guests what time they need to sow a measure of chaos, then order the Temple Knights to crush them.

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_V00090_LAHABREA
405.description: Excellent. All shall soon be in alignment.

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03003_V00100_LAHABREA
406.description: It is time for the Bringer of Light to die.
